primary_sources.title: Polar-metric/axial-gauge perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov wormhole
primary_sources.read_scope: Section 5.4 Choice of state and section 9 conclusions read completely; section 8.3 stability criterion and selected 8.6 closed-throat mode discussion screened.

findings: The leading symmetric-clock kernel is derived from known transparent CFT propagation and JT flux balance, matching the earlier subtracted spectrum including its real part.
Causal finite-history state data replace an instantaneous-vacuum assignment for the free return problem.
The leading free model excludes upper-half-plane clock poles, but a finite-channel decay interval and interacting 4D stability remain unproved.
The novelty searches did not establish a direct predecessor for the finite delayed common clock; they also do not establish absence of one.
rejected_search_results: Unrelated engineering JT results, unsupported wormhole-navigation specifications and prescribed-stress Casimir metrics were not used as primary support.
